NP Presspad 1.4.3 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

This release refreshes the libraries NP Presspad is built on. Everything here is under the hood; the app looks and works exactly as before.

## Dependency updates

- **Electron** 45.3.2 → 45.4.1 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime). This update pulls in the latest upstream security and stability fixes from the Electron 45 line.
- **Rich text editor (Tiptap)** 3.34.0 → 3.35.0 — the editor at the heart of writing and formatting your posts, with the latest upstream fixes; all `@tiptap/*` packages moved together.
- **Database engine (better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers)** 13.1.1 → 13.2.0 — the encrypted local store that keeps your posts and drafts safe offline.
- **Icons (Lucide)** 1.73.0 → 1.77.0 — the icon set used across the interface.
- **Markdown parser (marked)** 18.2.0 → 18.2.1 — used when rendering and converting content to Markdown.
- **Styling helper (tailwind-merge)** 3.7.0 → 3.7.1 — keeps the app's styling consistent.
- **Test tooling (Vitest)** 5.1.0 → 5.1.1 — development tooling only; none of it ships in the app.
